text:
emma-partnerships: Quick sync — NovaKey (marketplace partner) requested a coordinated dry-run for SSO (SAML), SCIM group sync, and BYOK/HSM wrap before we flip their listing live. Target window: next Tue morning. Who can own which part? :calendar:

liam-eng-security: Ill take SAML hardening + SCIM security checks. Need partner SP metadata and the attribute mapping they expect for 'entitlements'->roles. Also we should enable encrypted NameID and check ACS endpoints for http->https redirects.

raj-infra: I can do the HSM/BYOK validation. NovaKey uses PKCS#11 v2.40 and expects vendor attestation. Ill stand up a dedicated test HSM and validate key import, unwrap, and asymmetric sign paths. Estimate 3-4 hours.

marta-solutions: I'll own the acceptance criteria and customer-facing runbook. Draft acceptance: SAML login (sp- and idp-initiated), SCIM: bulk group sync (1000 users sample), deprovision, role mapping verified; KMS: import wrapped key, rotate, failover check within 2 minutes. Add anything else.

noah-devex: Add SDK example for customers showing how to call our secrets API when using partner keys. Small snippet to include in the docs: ```python
from redwood import SecretsClient
c = SecretsClient(api_key='REDACTED')
secret = c.get_secret('nova/connection', key='wrapped')
```

omlivia-sales: NovaKey marketing wants a joint announcement after a successful dry-run. Can we confirm run completion by Tue 14:00 PT so they can draft the post?

sophie-legal: I need confirmation DPA is signed and HSM attestation doc (FIPS/CC) is attached. If NovaKey requires additional SOC reports or subprocessor lists, flag here now.

liam-eng-security: Also suggest we run a SCIM negative test: send an oversized patch batch and confirm our rate-limiter returns 429 rather than partial failures. Use this curl to smoke: ```bash
curl -u scim-novakey:$(op get totp scim-novakey) -H "Content-Type:application/json" -X PATCH https://staging-novakey.example.com/scim/v2/Groups -d @bulk-patch.json```

raj-infra: deploy-bot created staging-novakey-2026 cluster and deployed: scim-proxy v1.0.0, sso-mock v0.3.2, kms-connector v1.9.0. Creds in 1password -> partnerships/novakey/staging. Health: scim-proxy (green), kms-connector (green), sso-mock (amber - needs metadata).

deploy-bot: Deployed staging-novakey-2026 -> services: scim-proxy, kms-connector, sso-mock. Health checks: 2/3 passing. Waiting for SAML metadata.

emma-partnerships: Action items: NovaKey to send SP metadata and SCIM base URL by EOD Fri. Liam to prepare audience/replay-tolerance checks. Raj to validate HSM attestation and key import. Marta to publish runbook and post-run rollback (revoke partner certs, switch to hosted keys). Marketing hold until success.

marta-solutions: I'll add monitoring hooks in Redwood Console for SAML latency, SCIM delta failures, and KMS unwrap errors and set temporary alert thresholds. Will post Confluence link shortly.

liam-eng-security: One more: enable SAML assertion encryption in staging and test decrypt with our SP cert. If NovaKey doesn't support encrypted assertions, fallback plan: require signed assertions + strict audience + short assertion TTL.

emma-partnerships: Great. I'll schedule the dry-run invite for Tue 09:30 PT and loop in NovaKey PM. Thanks everyone — please react when you've picked up your action. :thumbsup:
